Hi,

Here is what I see:

ORFL -Down to the left on a lower time frame:

We have a reaction (supply) and a reaction to the supply (Origin). Origin is tested and bounces price (ORFL).

Then, ORFL Down is itself engulfed and a new FL Box (red) is formed.

When the red FL Box it engulfed another FL Box is formed and we have a swap zone.

Like before, we have a reaction to a FL (the FL is neon green). There is
 also an engulf of a very small ORFL down, which occurs before the
larger reaction to the green FL. Just like before, price engulfs this
zone and another ORFL is formed. Test 1 to create supply:

After supply is formed by testing the ORFL Down, an opportunity to FO to
 MPL (deeper in to the ORFL) exists and price reacts accordingly. I
think this is why Omid went short at that level.

author: hoeschec
text:
samjardavid wrote: hi hoeschec ^_^

what the different between ORFL and FL? is ORFL more important than FL

Thank you in advance

David

Hi Samjardavid-

A FL is any FTR that holds price up or down whereas a ORFL is an origin up/down and a FL.

ORFL is often the target of longs/shorts, so they hold special
importance. Salivan discusses the concept of magnetic attraction vs.
repulsion and this is related specifically to ORFL's.
